handoff_status: Candidate engineering Task Contract input; PM may create but must separately authorize any engineering execution.
proposed_task_name: MVP 1.0 Fast Track Vertical Slice #1 — Project-backed Context Recovery
unique_user_result: Using only fixed synthetic data, a person can capture one immutable original, explicitly confirm its association to one preseeded Work Project-backed Context, reopen Today/Context, and inspect the related Memory provenance without any model call or silent Context creation.
duration_estimate: 4-5 focused engineering hours excluding PM acceptance and any separately required independent review.

vertical_slice.person: One local synthetic owner reference is the display/scope root; no Profile or inferred persona record is created.
vertical_slice.domain: One fixed Work view narrows UI/read projection only; it grants no authorization and activates no new Domain intelligence.
vertical_slice.context: One preseeded Project-backed ContextId, ctx:project:synthetic-lifeos-product, is derived from a Project identity. A captured Artifact may be associated only through explicit confirmation.
vertical_slice.memory: One read-only Memory detail resolves capture -> Source -> Project Context Link -> confirmation Feedback -> Audit/provenance references. It does not duplicate original content.
vertical_slice.global_ai_context: One preview-only Context Inspector displays Person + current Today/Context page + selected capture/Memory item, supports temporary removal, and does not call ModelPort or AgentPort.

allowed_successor_write_scope: A new task-specific engineering root and its new task-specific Evidence/deliverable directories, named by the PM task card.
A new task-specific temporary root exactly named in the future task card.
Only source files copied from a physical multiline positive allowlist of P3-126 candidate files.
protected_scope: All P3-126/P3-127 candidate, task, review, Evidence, Manifest, and historical roots remain read-only.
No real user data, Pilot, real database/path/text, network, cloud, third party, credential, Vault, file ingestion, model, Agent, export, clear/delete, recovery, sync, vector, or new active Domain.
No P3-116 visual redesign, new first-level IA, wide Sidebar, Domain dashboard, notification center, or standalone AI page.
